name: timekeeper
description: Dashboard estática de contadores com Firebase Auth e Firestore.

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run test:unit && npm run test:functions
scripts.check:syntax: node --check public/src/runtime-config.js && node --check public/src/time.js && node --check public/src/occurrences.js && node --check public/src/weather.js && node --check public/src/notifications.js && node --check public/src/soundscapes.js && node --check public/src/focus.js && node --check public/src/pwa.js && node --check public/sw.js && node --check public/src/analytics.js && node --check public/src/firebase.js && node --check scripts/serve-public.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.e2e.json --project demo-timekeeper --only auth,firestore,storage "playwright test"
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/unit/time.test.cjs tests/unit/occurrences.test.cjs tests/unit/weather.test.cjs tests/unit/notifications.test.cjs tests/unit/soundscapes.test.cjs tests/unit/nlp-parser.test.cjs tests/contracts/project.test.cjs
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.rules-test.json --project demo-timekeeper --only firestore,storage "node --test tests/rules/firestore.test.cjs"
